Breakeven.description:
When the stop moves to the entry's fill price, `offset_ticks` beyond it in the position's
favour.

offset_ticks.description: The ticks beyond the fill price in the position's favour; below zero, short of it.

Cooldown.description: How long no entry is placed after a losing trade.

oneOf.description: The next `bars` signal bars.
The next `minutes` minutes.

EntryOrder.description:
The order an entry signal places: a market order, or a limit or a stop-market order at the
signal frame's `entry_price` or a number of ticks from the signal bar's close. With a limit or
a stop entry, a bar with both entry signals places a buy and a sell as one OCO group, the long
and short pair; with a market entry, such a bar is refused.

oneOf.description: A market order (F-MKT).
A limit order at the signal frame's `entry_price` (F-LMT).

time_to_live_bars.description: The signal bars the order works before it is cancelled; without it, until it fills.

oneOf.description:
A limit order `ticks` from the signal bar's close, below it for a buy and above it for a
sell (F-LMT).

ticks.description: The distance from the close, in ticks.

time_to_live_bars.description: The signal bars the order works before it is cancelled; without it, until it fills.

oneOf.description: A stop-market order at the signal frame's `entry_price` (F-STP).

time_to_live_bars.description: The signal bars the order works before it is cancelled; without it, until it fills.

oneOf.description:
A stop-market order `ticks` from the signal bar's close, above it for a buy and below it
for a sell (F-STP).

ticks.description: The distance from the close, in ticks.

time_to_live_bars.description: The signal bars the order works before it is cancelled; without it, until it fills.

EntryWindow.description: A stretch of local time in which entries may be placed.

end.description:
The local time, `HH:MM`, at which the window closes; before `start`, it runs past
midnight.

start.description: The local time, `HH:MM`, at which the window opens.

weekdays.description: The days on which the window holds; without them, every day.

Execution.description:
The execution template: how the strategy enters on its signals, protects and closes a
position, filters its entries, and sizes them.

breakeven.description: When the stop moves to the entry's fill price.

entry.description: The order an entry signal places.

limits.description: A blackout column, daily limits, a cooldown, and fresh signals, which filter entries.

on_opposite_signal.description: What an entry signal against the open position does.

signal_exit.description: Whether the signal frame's `long_exit` and `short_exit` close the position.

sizing.description: How many units an entry trades.

stop.description: The stop placed against the position when an entry fills.

targets.description:
The targets placed when an entry fills, three at most, each closing a fraction of the
position still open; with the stop, they form one OCO group.

time.description: Entry windows and time exits, in local time.

trailing.description: How the stop follows the price.

Limits.description:
Filters on entries: a blackout column, daily limits, a cooldown after a loss, and fresh
signals.

blackout.description: A boolean feature column of the signal frame: no entry on a bar where it is true.

cooldown_after_loss.description: How long no entry is placed after a losing trade.

daily_loss_stop.description: The loss, in the account's currency, after which no entry is placed that trade date.

fresh_signal.description:
Whether an entry needs a signal that was false on the bar before, so that a signal still
true after an exit does not enter again.

max_losses_per_day.description: The losing trades after which no entry is placed that trade date.

max_trades_per_day.description: The entries allowed each trade date.

profit_lock.description: The profit, in the account's currency, after which no entry is placed that trade date.

OppositeSignal.description: What an entry signal against the open position does.

oneOf.description: Nothing: the position stays open.
The position is closed.
The position is closed and an entry is placed the other way.

ProfitTrigger.description: A point a trade reaches in its favour.

oneOf.description: The price `ticks` from the entry's fill in the position's favour.

ticks.description: The distance from the fill, in ticks.

oneOf.description: A profit of `multiple` times the trade's initial risk.

multiple.description: The multiple of the initial risk.

oneOf.description: The fill of a target, counted from 1.

Sizing.description:
How many units an entry trades: contracts for futures, the base asset for crypto, in whole lot
steps of the instrument. The signal frame's `size_mult` multiplies the size where it is given.

oneOf.description: The same units on every entry.
The units whose value at the entry is `amount` in the account's currency.

amount.description: The value of each entry, in the account's currency.

oneOf.description: The units whose loss at the stop is `amount` in the account's currency.

amount.description: The loss at the stop, in the account's currency.

oneOf.description:
The units whose loss at the stop is `percent` % of equity: the run's capital and its
closed profit and loss.

percent.description: The loss at the stop, as a percentage of equity: `1` is 1 %.

StopRule.description: The stop placed against the position when an entry fills, a stop-market order (F-STP).

oneOf.description: `ticks` from the entry's fill price.

ticks.description: The distance from the fill, in ticks.

oneOf.description: `percent` % of the entry's fill price from it.

percent.description: The distance from the fill, as a percentage of its price: `0.5` is 0.5 %.

oneOf.description: `multiple` times a feature of the entry's signal bar, such as its ATR, from the fill.

feature.description: The feature's column in the signal frame, such as `atr`.

oneOf.description: The signal frame's `stop_price` on the entry's signal bar, a raw price.

Target.description:
A target placed when an entry fills, a limit order (F-LMT) that closes `fraction` of the
position still open.

fraction.description: The fraction of the position still open that the target closes: 1 closes the rest.

oneOf.description: `ticks` from the entry's fill price, in the position's favour.

ticks.description: The distance from the fill, in ticks.

oneOf.description: `multiple` times a feature of the entry's signal bar, such as its ATR, from the fill.

feature.description: The feature's column in the signal frame, such as `atr`.

oneOf.description: `multiple` times the trade's initial risk, the distance from the fill to its first stop.

multiple.description: The multiple of the initial risk.

oneOf.description: The signal frame's `target_price` on the entry's signal bar, a raw price.

TimeRules.description: Entry windows and time exits, in local time of `tz`.

flat_by.description:
The local time, `HH:MM`, from which each trade date the position is closed and no entry
is placed: at the first signal close at or after that time on the trade date's own day,
which must fall inside its session, outside its halts, and on the signal bars' grid.

max_bars.description: The signal bars a position may stay open.

max_minutes.description: The minutes a position may stay open.

no_overnight.description: Whether the position is closed before each session's close.

no_weekend.description: Whether the position is closed before the last session of each week closes.

tz.description: The IANA time zone of the local times, such as `America/Chicago`.

windows.description: The local times in which entries may be placed; without any, at any time.

TrailBy.description: How far behind the price a trailing stop follows.

oneOf.description: `ticks` behind the best price since the activation.

ticks.description: The distance behind the best price, in ticks.

oneOf.description: `multiple` times a feature of the signal bars, such as their ATR, behind the best price.

feature.description: The feature's column in the signal frame, such as `atr`.

oneOf.description: At the signal frame's `trail_ref` of each signal bar, a raw price.
As the price moves inside a bar.
At each signal bar's close.

Trailing.description: A stop that follows the price once the trade reaches its activation.

activation.description: The point from which the stop follows; without it, from the entry's fill.

by.description: How far behind the price the stop follows.

step_ticks.description: The ticks the stop moves at a time; without it, every tick.

description:
A signal strategy's specification: the instrument it trades, the timeframe of the signal bars
whose closes decide, and its execution template.

execution.description: What the strategy does with its signals.

instrument.description: The root the strategy trades, as the instrument table names it, such as `ES`.

spec_version.description: The version of the document's layout: 1.

timeframe.description: The timeframe of the signal bars, such as `5m`: a count, then `s`, `m`, `h`, or `d`.
